source.prompt:
Fullscreen magical fire storm, giant pillars of orange and purple flame rising, burning ground, dramatic magic explosion, pixel art style, isolated on black background, no character.

FINAL OUTPUT REQUIREMENTS (editable)
Generate one animation contact sheet for the screen phase after studying every numbered action pose in the attached storyboard.
Return exactly one clean 2x2 contact sheet with four equal, unlabeled quadrants in normal reading order.
The first three quadrants show the same isolated VFX evolving from early state to strongest state to fading state. The fourth quadrant is completely empty background.
FULLSCREEN_TARGET_RESOLUTION: 1920x1080.
FULLSCREEN_CONTACT_SHEET_RESOLUTION: 3840x2160.
Each quadrant is one complete 16:9 full-screen frame.
The VFX composition must cover the full frame and remain visually active across at least 90% of both width and height; do not return a small centered icon with large empty borders.
Keep important energy, flames, particles and edge lighting inside the frame while allowing soft atmospheric falloff at all four edges.
ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT OR GLYPHS: do not render START, PEAK, DISSOLVE, EMPTY, frame numbers, panel numbers, captions, headings, labels, letters, words, logos, signatures or watermarks.
Do not draw panel separators, grid lines, borders, UI, characters, weapons, armor, bodies, faces, hands, scenery or ground.
Preserve the action pose direction, effect scale and timing implied by the red dashed allowed-VFX regions in the reference storyboard.
Use a pure black background suitable for additive blending.
